chapters.title: CORTEX
chapters.sub: WORKING PROTOTYPE · SYNTHETIC ACOUSTIC INPUT · LIVE MUJOCO SIMULATION
chapters.narration: Meet Cortex. Same words, different robot behavior. This demo uses synthetic vocal profiles, real MuJoCo physics, and a modeled San Francisco scene.

chapters.title: Step into the scene.
chapters.sub: FULL-DEPTH ARCHITECTURE · MODELED PARK · CAMERA PARALLAX
chapters.narration: Explore the Painted Ladies in three dimensions, with modeled buildings and a bounded walking area.

chapters.title: One set of tools. Keyboard or voice.
chapters.sub: HOLD W / A / S / D · Q / E TURN · SPACE STOPS
chapters.narration: Keyboard and voice share the same tools. Turn, walk, or stop. The robot faces its direction before moving.

chapters.title: “Come here.”
chapters.sub: CALM PROFILE · 0.55 M/S SPEED CEILING · NORMAL APPROACH
chapters.narration: First, calmly: Come here. The robot approaches at a moderate pace and maintains personal space.

chapters.title: “Come here.”
chapters.sub: IDENTICAL TRANSCRIPT · URGENT PROFILE · 0.90 M/S SPEED CEILING
chapters.narration: Now reset. Come here! Same words, different vocal intensity. Priority increases, and the robot walks faster, within its safety limits.

chapters.title: Same words. Different voice. Different physical policy.
chapters.sub: LOCAL ACOUSTIC CUES · GRADIUM + PIPECAT VOICE → DOCUMENTED MAPPING → SAFETY GOVERNOR → G1
chapters.narration: Inside Cortex, acoustic cues become a visible behavior policy. Gradium and Pipecat power the live voice path. This recording uses local planning.

chapters.title: Hesitation changes the response, too.
chapters.sub: CAUTIOUS APPROACH · 2.0 M PERSONAL SPACE · CONFIRMATION REQUIRED
chapters.narration: A hesitant profile makes the robot wait for confirmation, approach slowly, and leave more personal space.

chapters.title: “Where did you last see my backpack?”
chapters.sub: ACTUAL CAPTURED FRAME · OPERATOR-LABELED LOCAL MEMORY · PLANTER
chapters.narration: Where did you last see my backpack? Cortex retrieves a saved camera frame and its operator-labeled location: beside the planter.

chapters.title: “Take me there.”
chapters.sub: RETRIEVED EVIDENCE → REGISTERED WAYPOINT → PHYSICAL NAVIGATION
chapters.narration: Take me there. The remembered location becomes a navigation target.

chapters.title: “WAIT! STOP!”
chapters.sub: FAST REFLEX PATH · NO PLANNER ROUND TRIP
chapters.narration: Wait! Stop! The fast reflex bypasses planning and stops the robot. The trace separates command acknowledgement from physical settling.

chapters.title: “Continue, but slowly.”
chapters.sub: EXPLICIT RESUME · REDUCED 0.30 M/S SPEED CEILING
chapters.narration: Continue, but slowly. An explicit resume releases the stop and lowers the speed limit. Safety always takes priority.

chapters.title: CORTEX · Hear the human behind the instruction.
chapters.sub: GRADIUM · PIPECAT · SAMBANOVA · MUJOCO · SOURCE, TESTS & PITCH INCLUDED
chapters.narration: Cortex connects voice, memory, and safe action, with a SambaNova integration for high-level planning. Shared tools turn human intent into robot movement.

provenance: Actual application; synthetic acoustic fixtures; live MuJoCo; system-generated narration; Authored Painted Ladies architectural approximation and Alamo Square foreground; no photorealism claim; Indian English narration edition; source footage predates neighborhood refinement
